card.name: Linking words in tocilizumab label text
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation ("of", commas, "Cell") in biologic drug label text, especially before terms for infection, lab changes or autoimmune disease names. Also fires inside the brand name ACTEMRA and in section numbers.

modes.label: Of before risk terms
modes.description: The word "of" after nouns like management, risk or occurrence, right before a lab or infection term.
modes.example: Interruption of dosing may be needed for management<< of>> dose-related laboratory abnormalities including elevated liver enzymes

modes.label: Commas in disease lists
modes.description: A comma between abbreviated autoimmune conditions in an indication list.

modes.label: Inside names and headings
modes.description: Part of a disease or cell name or brand name, such as Giant Cell or ACTEMRA.
modes.example: Discontinue ACT<<EM>>RA Polyarticular and Systemic Ju

card.writes: It suppresses autoimmune and rheumatology word starts, so it seems to steer the model away from naming those conditions next.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in an arthritis biologic label just before disease or lab-result terms.
